classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Moves the bars and links of the tasks a Gantt cascade changed, from their previous to their final dates,
 * on one app-worker clock.
 * @description Bars ({@link Neo.gantt.Column#getDrawnSpan}) and links ({@link Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer#project})
 * both map a task's dates through the time axis. While a move runs, both read the task's in-flight span from the
 * chart's {@link Neo.gantt.Container#drawnSpans}, which only this class writes, so a link never leaves its bar.
 * The records hold their final dates throughout.
 *
 * The steps follow the chart's `--motion-panel` duration and `--ease-out-soft` easing, which {@link #readTokens}
 * reads from its node ahead of the moves. {@link #start} runs inside the chart's synchronous edit, after the
 * cascade's writes, and moves the tasks only on a positive tier: a `0ms` tier (reduced motion), or a read that
 * failed, found no tier or has not answered yet, leaves the edit's own repaint as the one update. When it moves
 * them, the rows those writes repainted send their update only after the current task, so its repaint at the
 * previous spans is what the browser shows first. {@link #end} lands a move at once; the chart calls it on a
 * scroll, a zoom, a store load, filter or sort, and before the next move. {@link #stop} drops it unpainted.
 * @class Neo.gantt.CascadeMotion
 * @extends Neo.core.Base
 */
classData.summary:
Moves the bars and links of the tasks a Gantt cascade changed, from their previous to their final dates,
on one app-worker clock.
classData.description:
Bars ({@link Neo.gantt.Column#getDrawnSpan}) and links ({@link Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer#project}) both map a task's dates through the time axis. While a move runs, both read the task's in-flight span from the chart's {@link Neo.gantt.Container#drawnSpans}, which only this class writes, so a link never leaves its bar. The records hold their final dates throughout.

The steps follow the chart's --motion-panel duration and --ease-out-soft easing, which {@link #readTokens} reads from its node ahead of the moves. {@link #start} runs inside the chart's synchronous edit, after the cascade's writes, and moves the tasks only on a positive tier: a 0ms tier (reduced motion), or a read that failed, found no tier or has not answered yet, leaves the edit's own repaint as the one update. When it moves them, the rows those writes repainted send their update only after the current task, so its repaint at the previous spans is what the browser shows first. {@link #end} lands a move at once; the chart calls it on a scroll, a zoom, a store load, filter or sort, and before the next move. {@link #stop} drops it unpainted.
classData.name: CascadeMotion

     */

Stops the clock and forgets the moving tasks without painting them, for a chart about to draw

classData.summary:
Reads the chart's motion tokens from its node, for the moves that follow. The chart reads them when
it switches the transition on and when it mounts, and {@link #start} after each move. Only the latest read
answers; one that fails or finds no tier keeps the tasks still, and lands a move that is running.
classData.name: readTokens
